title: Repeating-byte-alphabet invariant on the LP2 grid
question: Do equal-byte pairs in the LP2 grid support a periodically repeated one-to-one byte alphabet?
reader_question: Could a repeating byte alphabet explain the number grid?
summary: Exact Stage X2 replay checks both grid routes and every period 1–128. No period exceeds the uniform-null maximum; conditional plaintext-control exclusions range from 78 to 247 of 256 cells.
finding: No grid reading/period cell exceeds the maximum of 100,000 uniform-byte nulls. Under the source's lower 0.1% control rule, 241/256 cells are excluded for Emerson English, 247/256 for solved LP1 runes, 247/256 for HEX, and 78/256 for Base64. No decoding is produced.
limitations: The exclusions require a fixed bijection at each periodic residue and the source's exact plaintext-control classes and 256-byte representation. Other grid routes, transformations, layered ciphers and plaintext distributions remain outside scope.
next_steps: A proposed surviving period needs a specified key, decoding rule and held-out check. Alternate byte routes or control classes require their own declared test and controls.

scope.representation: The 256 printed grid tokens as base-60 bytes, traversed in printed 32×8 row order or column-major order.
scope.procedure: Replay only pinned Wulfic Stage X2 and independently reconstruct all 256 grid coincidence counts, pair capacities and source decisions; verify a planted residue-bijection invariant.
scope.parameters: Two readings × periods 1–128; 100,000 seeded uniform-null blocks; 9,024 Emerson, 2,646 solved-LP1, 10,000 HEX and 10,000 Base64 256-byte controls; source upper-maximum and lower-0.1%-quantile rules.
scope.exclusions: Other traversal routes, offsets, payload extraction, compression, non-bijective or changing alphabets, transposition, layered ciphers, and Stage X1/X3/X4 tests.

review.kind: exact public-source Stage X2 replay with independent complete grid-row check
review.reviewer: Pinned source table reproduced byte-for-byte; 256 site-grid counts and decisions independently checked; mathematical planted controls passed

reproduction.environment: Bundled verification uses Python 3 standard library. The optional full pinned-source replay needs NumPy and the external checkout.

visuals.caption: Conditional exclusions by plaintext-control class among 256 grid-reading/period cells. No cell had the source's positive structural signal.
